prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1355; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in a collision that occurred when the at-fault vehicle struck our client's vehicle while our client was turning left. Our client has sustained injuries that are currently under medical evaluation, and we expect the full extent of those injuries and associated losses to be documented as treatment continues.

Please direct all further communication regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or in person. If your insured or any other party contacts our client, please let us know immediately.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to your insured for this loss, along with a declarations page confirming those limits and any other coverage that may apply.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence related to this incident, including photographs, vehicle data and telematics, dashcam or surveillance footage, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or total loss records. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to this office.
